hook.name: UnihoodHook
hook.description: A single global hook for UNIHOOD pools on Robinhood Chain that charges a time-decaying swap fee (15% → 5% → 1%) on the native-ETH side, split among creator, a self-building bid wall (single-sided ETH liquidity placed below spot), and a platform treasury. External LP is locked until pool graduation. All fee parameters are immutable at deploy.
